title: CaVe-VLM-CoT：一种可解释的视觉语言模型框架
summary: CaVe-VLM-CoT 是一个模块化的基于反思的智能体RAG框架，通过五阶段闭环流程（提取器、检索器、求解器、引用注入器、验证器）强制进行证据推理，检测到无依据声明时触发结构化反馈以进行针对性重新检索。提出23个组件级指标和复合指标CaVeScore，在ScienceQA和MMMU上分别达到87.1%和55.2%的准确率。
summary_en: CaVe-VLM-CoT is a modular reflection-based agentic-RAG framework that enforces evidence-grounded reasoning through a five-stage closed-loop pipeline, achieving 87.1% accuracy on ScienceQA and 55.2% on MMMU with 23 component-wise metrics and a composite CaVeScore.
